legend: On the Ovine Island, you are in charge of a herd of big fat sheeps.

To protect them from big bad wolves, you have arranged them into an n×m%%ZSMJ0%% rectangular pen (n,m≤2000%%ZSMJ1%%). Each cell in the pen is either empty (weight 0%%ZSMJ2%%) or contains a sheep with weight gi,j,%%ZSMJ3%% an integer between [1,106]%%ZSMJ4%%.
Your boss is wondering if there are special properties of the weights of your sheep.

You are given q%%ZSMJ5%% queries, each describing a rectangle. For each rectangle, consider all non-empty weights inside it. Determine whether you can choose three different cells in the rectangle such that if their weights are a,b,c%%ZSMJ6%%, then the largest of them is strictly less than half of their sum: max(a,b,c)<a+b+c2.%%ZSMJ7%%
input: The first line contains two integers n%%ZSMJ8%% and m%%ZSMJ9%% (1≤n,m≤2000%%ZSMJ10%%).
The next n%%ZSMJ11%% lines each contain m%%ZSMJ12%% integers gi,j%%ZSMJ13%% (0≤gi,j≤106%%ZSMJ14%%), where gi,j=0%%ZSMJ15%% means the cell is empty.
The next line contains an integer q%%ZSMJ16%% (1≤q≤105%%ZSMJ17%%).

Each of the next q%%ZSMJ18%% lines contains four integers x1,y1,x2,y2%%ZSMJ19%% (1≤x1≤x2≤n%%ZSMJ20%%, 1≤y1≤y2≤m%%ZSMJ21%%), describing a rectangle with corners (x1,y1)%%ZSMJ22%% and (x2,y2)%%ZSMJ23%% (inclusive).
output: For each query, print YES (case-insensitive) if there exist three different non-empty cells inside the rectangle whose weights satisfy max(a,b,c)<a+b+c2,%%ZSMJ24%% and print NO (case-insensitive) otherwise.
note: This rectangle covers the entire grid. The non-empty weights inside are: {1,2,3,10,4}%%ZSMJ25%%.
We need three different cells with weights a,b,c%%ZSMJ26%% such that max(a,b,c)<a+b+c2.%%ZSMJ27%%
Choose the triple (2,3,4)%%ZSMJ28%%. We have max(2,3,4)=4%%ZSMJ29%% and 2+3+42=92=4.5%%ZSMJ30%%.
Therefore, the answer for Query 1 is YES%%ZSMJ32%%.
This rectangle covers row 2%%ZSMJ34%% and columns 1%%ZSMJ35%% through 3%%ZSMJ36%%. The non-empty weights inside are: {2,3,10}%%ZSMJ37%%.
The only possible triple is (2,3,10)%%ZSMJ38%%. We have max(2,3,10)=10%%ZSMJ39%% and 2+3+102=152=7.5%%ZSMJ40%%.
Since 10≮7.5%%ZSMJ41%%, the condition does not hold.
Therefore, the answer for Query 2 is NO%%ZSMJ42%%.
